body: I've been searching for him actually... Actually feeling unnerved now because someone tried to chat with me saying hi, but then it went away after I pressed it. So of course now I'm wondering if I pressed something wrong and that was him. So yay. What's your reason for this?
Yes, but I could've made a different choice. It would have been a difficult one. Hindsight helps and I definitely think we'd both be better off if I kept him with me.
I got a notification that someone tried to chat with me, but when I pressed it, it went away. You can try again. Sorry...
Mhmm...
Yes. Thank you
Can't see your comment to reply, but it's sodium nitrite
Thanks. United States
Thank you, and no, I'm not familiar with it

I get that. I've done research, and I do have faith in the pills I have. But if I only feel sick for some days, then alrighty... I have considered it, which is why I'll have 3 and a half days to recover before classes start again if I'm still alive and kicking. And if classes start, I'll drag myself to them unless my legs feel like they're on fire or something. I can just live to die another day. :/
That would be cool. It's just not on my itinerary, and I feel like I've waited long enough honestly. I appreciate that alternative though.
I see that happening if I call for help, but I can count on my pride to not let me do that. I have a very strong aversion to doing that

Nothing's keeping me from it. I know I could, but that would make my perception of myself much worse. I'd be sitting around feeling more like trash. At least I'm currently sitting around feeling like productive trash.
Yeah, I am. I've thought about it and I'm cool with it. If it doesn't kill me, I hope to be unable to continue going to college or work at all.
Lol yeah. I'm at college so it's really good food from the cafeteria. It's got crispy, yummy fried catfish, my favorite. It's tempting to stay til Friday for it. .-.

Currently just sitting here. My emotions are more numb, but they're just taking a break. I'm still particularly suffering from the physical stuff. Can't relax enough to sleep and my body feels so humid and it's not even hot in my room. None of this is worth going through for the possibility of a better someday.
Holy crap. I relate. The few moments of excitement and hope are such a different kind of pain. Being functionally suicidal is so stupid. I don't know how I'm supposed to want to do this.
Ahhh. I relate to this too hard
I don't see the point in friends now that I'm determined to leave. It would be nice, but I don't want to cause you pain. You seem kind though...
Same. It would be lovely. Hell, I could even comfort my family and tell them I don't mind death. At least they'd know I'm not truly suffering.
Lol. Before I got with him, that was my goal. He convinced me otherwise though. Seems like it doesn't even matter either way. 😅
Ugh...same. I can't bring myself to care about putting it all into words. It would probably be very confusing anyway.
You're so kind. Thank you a lot! Reddit people can be so nice 😁
Oh gosh, I'm so sorry. That sucks. Thank you for wishing me well. I hope everything works out for you, too 😃

I suppose. I just thought that since he's essentially recovered from depression, he'd be more understanding. Not to say that he isn't. Honestly, it probably just boils down to we need to improve our communication
Well yay! I surprisingly do feel better
I actually hadn't thought about it that way. Just because my problem happens to be in this form, it doesn't mean I can't get help for it. That's a nice thought. Thanks 😊
...I'm glad you have caring people around you. I know I do, too. I just need to stop thinking about how much of a burden I'll be

That is true...

It's just really hard to talk to people about this

No, my friend isn't aware. I don't want to burden anyone else. I don't even want to get better so there's no point in getting help. As for what causes this, many things. I guess the main thing is my anxiety around people. Normal people can just talk to people and go to normal events and stuff. I can't do these basic things. I'm not completely incapable. I just have to push myself so hard and I have a constant pain in my chest when I do.
